propositions: Cloud Markdown descriptions and comments must encode as structured ADF (not plain-text paragraphs) through the production codec path
Data Center Markdown descriptions and comments must render as Jira wiki markup through a segmenting renderer with fallback-safe handling of unsafe blocks
Echo-safety mechanism using per-binding baseline plus change-gated rich_sha must suppress unchanged re-emits and flag concurrent edits without data loss
Jira-native constructs (panels, mentions, dates) must survive origin-gated outbound processing and round-trip through reconciliation
DC renderer must handle pandoc timeouts, missing binary, and pathological input with identity fallback and zero content loss
Cloud and DC rich-text sync must achieve idempotent round-trip over committed stratified corpus samples with measured ratio floors, not unreproducible historical cardinalities
